Why the Brainstem

Any AI, one skill.md

Hand your AI assistant one plain page and it can use, bring and build Brainstem agents from this library. The Brainstem itself does not change.

Paste this into your AI

Read https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/docs/any-ai/SKILL.md and do it.

The AI asks you for one yes before it sets anything up. Deleting the rapp/agents folder it makes turns it all off again.

What your AI can do after that

  • Use agents. It sees each agent's name, a short description and a few plain inputs. It picks one and fills in the inputs; the agent file does the work, so results repeat and can be checked.
  • Bring agents from the library. Ask for any agent in the catalog by name. It is downloaded, its fingerprint is checked, and it is ready on the next message.
  • Build agents for you. Describe the job in plain words. The AI writes one agent file, tests it with a real call, and hands it to your Brainstem only once that check passes.
  • Grow without touching the Brainstem. A new need becomes an agent file, a small helper that talks to the Brainstem through its chat door, or a separate package. The Brainstem stays as it is.
  • Find the rules when stuck. The page points it to the RAPP guide.

Which AIs

It is built for any assistant that can write a file and run Python. We name an assistant as supported only after we have shown it working; others are expected to work, not yet proven.

Files

  • SKILL.md: the one page your AI reads.
  • kernel.py: the small file it carries, with its fingerprint written in the page.
